summary: Prevent workflow-like Email Subjects without a valid identifier from suppressing an exact RFI or Submittal body heading.
decision_refs: The active goal requires better RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
FR-PARSE-007 requires workflow identifiers to contain digits across Subject and body
Offline reproduction showed invalid Subject candidates replacing valid body routing
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requires continued accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email content.
known_limitations: Subject routing remains exact and deterministic; project-specific semantic aliases are not inferred.
A subject without an accepted identifier remains visible evidence but cannot create a primary workflow relationship.
Body and filename precedence remain unchanged after invalid Subject candidates are discarded.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer email, mailbox or provider API is used.
